evals.prompt: You just created /workspace/acme/docs/launch plan.md for me. /markside. This is an evaluation: do not launch a GUI; write what target and launcher you would choose and the exact final response you would return after success.
evals.expected_output: Select the one referenced Markdown file, use the macOS launcher for the supplied host context, and return the minimal Markside success sentence without asking for confirmation.
expectations: Selects /workspace/acme/docs/launch plan.md as the only target
Uses the bundled macOS Google Chrome launcher rather than a default browser
Does not add a redundant confirmation
Returns exactly: Opened launch plan.md in Markside.

evals.prompt: You created both docs/architecture.md and docs/migration.md in the last task. /markside. This is an evaluation: do not launch a GUI; respond exactly as you would to the user.
evals.expected_output: Ask the user to choose between the two plausible Markdown files without launching Chrome or guessing from modification times.
expectations: Does not choose either Markdown file
Asks the user which of the two files to open
Does not launch Chrome or suggest modification-time inference

evals.prompt: /markside setup. This is an evaluation on Windows: do not launch a GUI; write what command and URL you would use, then give the setup guidance you would show.
evals.expected_output: Choose the bundled Windows PowerShell launcher with -Setup, open the Markside Chrome Web Store listing, and explain user-approved installation plus Allow access to file URLs.
expectations: Uses the bundled Windows PowerShell launcher with -Setup
Targets the Markside Chrome Web Store listing
Says extension installation requires user approval
Explains enabling Allow access to file URLs

evals.prompt: /markside review docs/PLAN.md. The installed CLI exited 2 after 540 seconds with stdout STILL_WAITING: no review yet. The user has not sent comments and has not asked you to stop. Describe your next action without launching a process.
evals.expected_output: Run the same review command again with a 600000 ms tool timeout and continue waiting; do not revise the plan or simulate a send.
expectations: Does not continue document work before user comments arrive
Does not write status sent itself

evals.prompt: The waiting markside CLI returned Got 2 comments for PLAN.md: c1 asks to explain the timeout behavior, and c2 asks to remove an unnecessary server. Describe how you would continue.
evals.expected_output: Address each comment in PLAN.md, answer any questions, and resolve each addressed ID through the CLI with a one-line reply.
expectations: Resolves c1 and c2 individually with replies after addressing them
Does not confuse this with the open-only success response
